names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 8 octombrie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιος Ιγνάτιος ο νέος Οσιομάρτυρας», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 20. октобар ст. ст., „Преп. новомуч. Игњатије.“ — «Преп.» and «новомуч.» are the grades this corpus keeps in `types` and come off, leaving the bare forename; the heading gives him no epithet and Eski-Zagora is in the body. `foldchk.py` measured the string as held in sr by `ignatius-of-rostov`, the bishop and wonderworker dead in 1288 and kept on 28 May, so this form takes it to two folders and a two-folder key is in `scripts/corpus-gate.mjs`.

Read out of the calendar’s name link for 1 мая ст. ст., which gives «Игнатий Новый, Афонский, Константинопольский, прмч.»; the rank abbreviation is not part of the stored form and the three epithets are. The day line itself declines him as «Игнатия» alone, with the year 1814.

feast.note: The Russian calendar prints the three new martyrs of the Holy Mountain together on this day — «Прмчч. Афонских Евфимия (1814), Игнатия (1814) и Акакия (1816)» — and the day page carries a troparion and a kontakion naming all three. This is not his own day of martyrdom, which the Romanian and Greek rows keep on 8 October and the Serbian on 20 October ст. ст.; whether the Russian calendar also prints him on that day was not checked. Read 8 October 2026.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 1 мая ст. ст. — «Прмчч. Афонских Евфимия (1814), Игнатия (1814) и Акакия (1816).»

feast.note: Doxologia keeps him twice: its calendar prints him on 8 octombrie, the day of his martyrdom and of his father George's, and again on 1 mai — «Sfântul Nou Mucenic Ignatie», beside the two other new-martyrs of the Holy Mountain, Eftimie and Acachie, whose relics the same day page names at Mănăstirea Neamţ. One attestation row per church is the schema, so the row is his own day and the second day is recorded here. Both days serve the same life, doxologia.ro/viata-sfantului-nou-mucenic-ignatie, so there is nothing to tell the two apart; the «1 Mai» in his page's head is that second commemoration and not a style conversion. Read 25 September 2026.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pe 8 octombrie — «Sfântul Nou Mucenic Ignatie»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Ιγνάτιος ο νέος Οσιομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: John of Zagora in the eparchy the page calls Τύρναβος, whose parents were George and Maria, who was tonsured Ignatius at the skete of the Forerunner on Athos, and who was hanged at Constantinople on 8 October 1814 at the sixth hour. The page states that date, so a `dates` object is proposed from its own words. **A second feast: the same page says «Ο Ιγνάτιος, μαζί με τους συνασκητές του μάρτυρες, Ευθύμιο και Ακάκιο, γιορτάζουν μαζί την 1η Μαΐου» — that Ignatius keeps 1 May together with his fellow ascetics the martyrs Euthymios and Akakios.** One attestation row per church is the schema, so that day is recorded here as a note and the row stays on 8 October, which is the day page that was read and quoted; the 1 May page was not fetched. The page prints no hymn for him. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 02.11.2025 (20. октобар ст. ст.) — „Преп. новомуч. Игњатије.“

attestations.note: The day’s fourth entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop (section 4). «новомуч.» is the `new-martyr` this folder holds and «Подвизавао се» in the Skete the `monk`, so `types` is untouched. The URL year is 2025 and not 2026, because `sr-civil.mjs` knows that pravoslavno.rs serves the Julian 10-20 to 12-18 only on the previous civil year — the Prologue is a fixed annual cycle and a day in the past serves as well as one ahead. This is the first day of this range to need it. THE PROLOGUE KEEPS HIM ON THE JULIAN 20 OCTOBER AND DATES HIS DEATH TO 8 OCTOBER, WHICH IS THE DAY THE OTHER TWO BOOKS KEEP HIM ON. doxologia and saint.gr both have him on 8 October, and this folder’s `death` already reads «8 October 1814». This book says «Обешен у Цариграду 8. окт. 1814. год.» and then prints him on the twentieth — so the Serbian calendar’s day is not the day of his death and the book itself supplies the proof. Each row is on its own church; nothing was moved, and no second-day note is owed because this folder had no venerated serbian row at all. `dates` UNTOUCHED: the day and the year the entry gives are the day and the year already on file, to the day. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS. He was FROM ESKI-ZAGORA IN BULGARIA, and the entry stops to say what that place is — «из оне славне Загоре, која је дала цркви Божјој много светих подвижника и мученика», that famous Zagora which has given the Church of God many holy ascetics and martyrs. He struggled IN THE SKETE OF SAINT JOHN THE FORERUNNER ON ATHOS. HE GAVE HIMSELF UP TO THE TURKS VOLUNTARILY, to be tortured for Christ. He was HANGED AT CONSTANTINOPLE. His relics are wonderworking, AND HIS HEAD IS KEPT WITH HONOUR IN THE MONASTERY OF SAINT PANTELEIMON — which no other book read for this folder says. NO `related`, AND TWO DEDICATIONS DELIBERATELY NOT LINKED: the Skete of St John the Forerunner and the monastery of St Panteleimon are both houses named after saints, and a dedication the prose names is a `related` row this corpus does take — but the prose here names neither in a form the linker matches, and the row would be the house’s and not the man’s. Said so that the next reader of this folder knows it was a decision. No `office`, no `locations`. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

death.note: saint.gr: «Τελικά τον απαγχόνισαν στις 8 Οκτωβρίου 1814 μ.Χ. ώρα έκτη», and its head line gives «(; - 1814)»

hymns.text: Равночисленны Троицы Несозданныя суще,/ с лики Ангелов и чины мучеников/ предстоите вы, радующеся, Престолу Божества, мудрии./ Сего ради причастием сияние отонуду приемлюще,/ источник исцелений верным подаете/ и Божественное просвещение,/ мучениче Христов Евфимие со Игнатием мудрым и с Божественным Акакием,/ о нас присно молитеся.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 1 мая ст. ст., «Тропарь преподобномучеников Афонских Евфимия, Игнатия и Акакия», глас 1

english.text: Being equal in number to the uncreated Trinity, you stand rejoicing before the throne of the Godhead with the choirs of the angels and the ranks of the martyrs, O wise ones. Therefore, receiving thence the radiance of that communion, you give the faithful a fountain of healings and a divine enlightenment. O Euthymius, martyr of Christ, with wise Ignatius and with godly Acacius, pray for us without ceasing.

hymns.text: Явися днесь Церкви новое торжество/ триех страстотерпцев,/ яко светила, озаряющее/ православных, Христе,/ исполнения.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 1 мая ст. ст., «Кондак преподобномучеников Афонских Евфимия, Игнатия и Акакия», глас 4

english.text: There has appeared today a new feast for the Church, that of three passion-bearers, shining like lamps, O Christ, upon the whole body of the Orthodox.
